name: Build a Fishing Empire!
desc:
Build a Fishing Empire is live! 
UPGRADE YOUR BEST FISHERMEN TO RULE THE SEAS! 🌊  

🎣 Hire a fisherman or even a full-sized trawler!  
🚤 Place it at your base  
🐟 Automatically catch rare fish  
💰 Sell your haul for massive profits  
🕒 Your crew keeps fishing even while you’re offline!  
Come back anytime to collect your rewards!
